text: Iron Mountain became a publicly traded company in 1996; its common stock is traded on the NYSE under the symbol IRM.
short: Iron Mountain has been public since 1996 (NYSE: IRM).

source.name: Iron Mountain: Our history
source.quote: Upon reaching an annual revenue of $100 million, Iron Mountain became a publicly traded company in 1996.
